Message:
scsi: qla4xxx: Format SYSFS_FLAG_FW_SEL_BOOT as byte

qedi formats SYSFS_FLAG_FW_SEL_BOOT as a byte and the qla4xxx driver does
exactly the same thing. Align them for consistency.
